# Lifetime Transfer

A gift or transfer made during the testator's lifetime, relevant for tax calculations such as the UK 7-year rule, US unified gift/estate tax, and similar lookback provisions in other jurisdictions

Source: [`v3/lifetime-transfer.json`](../../v3/lifetime-transfer.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/lifetime-transfer.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this lifetime transfer within the INHERIT document |
| `transferDate` | `string` (date) | yes | Date the transfer was made |
| `donorPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Person.id of the donor (typically the testator) |
| `donorPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced donor person |
| `doneePersonIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of the recipients of the transfer |
| `transferType` | one of `gift`, `potentially_exempt_transfer`, `chargeable_lifetime_transfer`, `gift_with_reservation`, `failed_pet`, `settlement`, `advancement`, `loan_forgiveness`, `sale_at_undervalue`, `gift_of_shares`, `other` | yes | The category of lifetime transfer |
| `value` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Value of the transfer at the date it was made, in minor currency units |
| `assetId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Asset.id of the asset transferred, if it is still recorded in the document |
| `propertyId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Property.id of the property transferred |
| `valuationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to a Valuation entity providing a formal valuation of the transferred asset |
| `exemptionsClaimed` | array of `object` | | Exemptions and reliefs claimed against this transfer to reduce its taxable value |
| `taxReturnFiled` | `boolean` | | Whether a gift tax return or similar filing has been submitted for this transfer |
| `taxPaid` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Amount of tax paid on this transfer, in minor currency units |
| `lookbackRelevant` | `boolean` | | Whether this transfer falls within the jurisdiction's lookback period for tax purposes (e.g. 7 years in the UK, 3 years in the US for certain gifts) |
| `lookbackYearsRemaining` | `number` | | Years remaining in the lookback period. In the UK, this counts down from 7 — a PET made 4 years before death has 3 years remaining |
| `taperReliefPercentage` | `number` | | UK taper relief percentage reducing the IHT charge on failed PETs and CLTs. Ranges from 0% (3 years or less before death) to 40% reduction (6-7 years before death) |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction governing this lifetime transfer |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this lifetime transfer |
| `doneeOrganisationIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Organisation IDs of the recipients of the transfer, if gifts were made to organisations (e.g. charities) |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `lookbackPeriod` | `object` | | Jurisdiction-specific lookback period for this lifetime transfer — determines tax liability based on proximity to date of death |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
